name: M107 Joint Motor
notes: High-torque internal-rotor PMSM joint used across the Unitree H1 humanoid; the same M107 unit is deployed at different gear stages for different joints -- Unitree quotes 360 N.m (knee), 220 N.m (hip), 75 N.m (arm), 45 N.m (ankle). Peak torque here uses the 360 N.m knee figure. 107x74mm, hollow shaft for cable routing, industrial crossed-roller output bearing. Manufacturer states 189 N.m/kg torque density; weight_g (~1.9 kg) is INFERRED from 360 N.m / 189 (N.m/kg) and is not a directly published value. Gear ratio, voltage, comm bus and price are not published for the bare motor (sold as part of H1); left null.

name: RMD-X10-S2 V3 (1:35)
notes: High-reduction planetary joint (MC-X-500 driver). Peak 100 N.m per RobotShop, rated 50 N.m at 50 rpm. Weight ~2.16 lb (~980 g) per Amazon listing used for torque density. Good for high-torque, low-speed arm joints.

name: RMD-X8-120
notes: High-torque, large-hollow-bore planetary joint for arm base/humanoid joints. Model name '120' = 120 N.m peak (one distributor lists 110 N.m peak / 574 W); rated torque not clearly published. Gear ratio ~20:1 inferred from part code RMD-X8-P20-120. EtherCAT and CAN driver variants.

name: RobStride 04 (RS-04)
notes: Top of the RobStride QDD line: four-in-one integrated joint (driver + BLDC motor + planetary reducer + dual magnetic encoders), 120x56mm body. Rated output power 700W +/-10% at 48V. Planetary (not true cycloidal) but marketed as a premium high-torque integrated joint. No-load output speed not published by manufacturer. Price is dealer/quote dependent (retail via AliExpress/resellers, typically a few hundred USD); not confirmed so left null.

name: GIM6010-36 (48V)
notes: Steel two-stage 36:1 planetary joint module with a published ~15 arcmin gearbox backlash (important for arms). GDS6 48 V config: 221 W, 18 N.m rated, 41 N.m stall; alternate GDZ468H config lists 17.4/51.5 N.m with CAN+RS485. Weight 574 g with driver (546 g without). Output speed 50-97 rpm depending on driver.

name: RobStride 03 (RS-03)
notes: Four-in-one integrated joint (driver + motor + planetary reducer + dual magnetic encoders). 195 rpm no-load output speed, 380W rated output at 48V, 0.6A no-load current, Class B insulation. Voltage listed as 48V rated. Planetary reducer, marketed as premium high-torque integrated joint. Price quote/reseller dependent, left null.

name: STS3250 (12V, 50 kg.cm)
notes: Heavy-duty all-metal, coreless-motor, dual-shaft bus servo. Stall torque 50 kg.cm = 4.9 N.m and speed 0.133 s/60 deg (~75 rpm) quoted at 12V. Same TTL protocol/form factor as the STS3215; used in beefier open-source arms and legs.

name: XM540-W270-T
notes: Coreless-motor sibling of the XH540 in the same frame, tuned for higher torque and lower speed. Stall torque 10.6 N.m and no-load 30 rpm quoted at 12.0V. Full 6-mode control. -T is TTL; -R is RS-485.

name: XH540-W270-T
notes: High-torque metal-gear X servo. Stall torque 9.9 N.m @12.0V (rises to ~10.6 N.m @14.8V); no-load 39 rpm @12V. Rated backlash 15 arcmin. Used in larger research arms and quadruped legs. -T is TTL; -R is RS-485.

name: GIM8108-8
notes: MIT-Cheetah-style QDD clone with very high torque density. 22 Nm stall / 7.5 Nm rated, 8:1 steel planetary (~15 arcmin backlash), nominal 110 rpm / max 320 rpm after reduction, 336W, 48V nominal (24-56V). SDC-series driver with CAN and USB-C config. Weight 375 g (net; ~0.8 kg gross shipping). Price roughly $55-112/unit wholesale (Alibaba, MOQ 2); no confirmed retail USD, so null.

name: AK10-9 (V3.0 KV60)
notes: Largest AK-series QDD, for big-dog legs and heavy arms. V3.0 KV60: 53 Nm peak / 18 Nm rated, rated current 10.7A. max_speed_rpm is rated speed at 48V. Earlier V2.0 KV60 rated 48 Nm peak / 18 Nm. Pricing varies widely by retailer/version (RobotShop lists V3.0 KV60 ~$1,140; historical V2 street ~$400-500) so price_usd left null.

name: STS3215 (12V, 30 kg.cm)
notes: The default actuator of the LeRobot SO-ARM100/SO-101 arms. Stall torque 30 kg.cm = 2.94 N.m and no-load 45 rpm (0.222 s/60 deg) quoted at 12V; a common 7.4V variant gives ~19.5 kg.cm = 1.91 N.m. Ships in multiple gear-ratio SKUs (1:147 C046, 1:191 C044, 1:345 C001/C018). Half-duplex TTL serial bus, position + wheel (velocity) modes.

name: ST3215 Serial Bus Servo (30 kg.cm)
notes: Waveshare-branded Feetech STS3215 (magnetic-encoder bus servo), servo/motor mode switchable. Torque 30 kg.cm = 2.94 N.m @12V (19.5 kg.cm = 1.91 N.m @7.4V variant); no-load 45 rpm (0.222 s/60 deg) @12V; locked-rotor 2.7A. A faster ST3215-HS variant trades to ~20 kg.cm / 106 rpm. Weight listed 55-68 g across sources (55 g used). Used in Waveshare RoArm kits and LeRobot builds.

name: H54-200-S500-R (Dynamixel PRO)
notes: Original Dynamixel PRO H-series (predecessor to the Pro+ PH54), a 200W RS-485 joint used in full-size humanoids/large arms. Retailer spec sheets cite stall torque 44.7 N.m and no-load 33.1 rpm at 24V; weight 855 g. Torque figure may reflect the rated value carried over from the Pro+ line - treat peak as approximate. Largely superseded by PH54.

name: XM430-W350-T
notes: Metal-gear, coreless-motor workhorse. Stall torque 4.1 N.m and no-load 46 rpm quoted at 12.0V. Full 6-mode control including current (torque). Backbone of Trossen ViperX/WidowX and ALOHA/OpenManipulator-X arms. -T is TTL; -R variant is RS-485.

name: AK80-9 (V3.0 KV100)
notes: The canonical MIT-Cheetah-style QDD module. V3.0 KV100 rates 22 Nm peak / 9 Nm continuous (earlier V1/V2 were 18 Nm peak). No-load 570 rpm, rated 390 rpm at 48V. Supports CubeMars 'servo' and 'MIT' hybrid modes; needs an external CAN adapter. Price ~$580 street (RobotShop sale $579.90, list $599.90).

name: RobStride 00
notes: Smallest RobStride QDD integrated module. 14 N.m peak, 10:1 reduction, dual 14-bit encoders, CAN, MIT-mode control. Rated torque and voltage not clearly published on primary sources.

name: RobStride 01
notes: Compact 36 V-nominal QDD module (24-48 V range). 17 N.m peak, 7 N.m rated at 100 rpm, 7.75:1 reduction, single magnetic encoder. Rated torque quoted at 100 rpm; no-load max speed not published.

name: GO-M8010-6
notes: Joint motor from the Unitree Go1 quadruped. Manual gives 23.7 Nm max output torque, 30 rad/s (~286 rpm) max speed, torque constant 0.63895 Nm/A (at output), max current 40A, 6.33:1 reduction, built-in FOC. Continuous/rated torque not published (comparison sources cite ~9-10 Nm). Weight ~530 g per manual (some resellers list 420-440 g). Voltage 24V recommended (manual cites 12-30V; some listings up to 48V). Uses Unitree's RS-485/serial bus, not CAN. Price ~$369 (Unitree shop).

name: SCA QDD-Lite-NE30-36
notes: Smart Compliant Actuator used in the INNFOS Gluon desktop cobot arm; integrates reducer + outer-rotor motor + precision encoder + collision detection + driver. QDD-Lite-NE30-36: 2.3 N.m rated / 10 N.m peak, 30 rpm rated output, 52mm dia x 68.8mm, 232.1g. Directly regulates position/velocity/torque/impedance. This is the smallest/lightest premium joint here (cobot-scale, not heavy-arm). INNFOS branding is largely defunct (innfos.com domain for sale; project continued under Mintasca) so availability marked unknown. Voltage not confirmed from primary source.

name: RobStride 02
notes: Dual-encoder sibling of RobStride 01. 17 N.m peak, 7.75:1 reduction, 48 V nominal, ~170 W, dual 14-bit magnetic encoders, CAN with MIT-mode control. Rated (continuous) torque not clearly published.

name: LPA-20 (Low Profile Rotary Actuator)
notes: Low-profile integrated servo actuator aimed at humanoid/cobot joints and surgical robotics. Combines zero-backlash Harmonic Drive gearing, brushless servomotor, brake, dual absolute encoders and integrated servo drive (CANopen/EtherCAT). Gear ratios 51/81/101:1. Continuous torque 6.5-16.9 N·m and maximum (peak) torque 34-57 N·m depending on ratio; values recorded are the top-of-range (101:1) figures. Weight ~1.4 kg (approx). torque_density computed from peak 57 N·m / 1.4 kg. Repeatability not published in accessible sources. Voltage class assumed 48V (typical for the line) - not confirmed from a primary datasheet. Quote-only pricing.

name: AK70-10 (KV100)
notes: High torque-density QDD widely used in DIY quadrupeds and jumping-leg research. 24.8 Nm peak / 8.3 Nm rated. max_speed_rpm is manufacturer rated speed at 48V (148 rpm at 24V). Price ~$399 (CubeMars store $398.90).

name: CyberGear Micromotor
notes: Xiaomi's low-cost MIT-Cheetah-style micromotor (from the CyberDog / CyberOne ecosystem), popular for hobby legs and arms. 12 Nm peak / 4 Nm continuous, 7.75:1 reduction, 24V, max 296 rpm, 14-bit encoder, CAN (1 Mbps) plus serial, integrated FOC driver with position/velocity/torque/impedance (MIT) modes. Manufacturer-stated torque density 37.85 Nm/kg. Listed EOL by some distributors; street price historically ~$80-120, so price_usd left null.

name: qdd100 beta 3
notes: Open-source QDD servo built on the moteus controller (CAN-FD, 5 Mbps). Thermal-limited torque at 24V: 16 Nm peak (<1s), 10 Nm for 60s, 6 Nm for 400s, 3.3 Nm indefinitely (rated_torque_nm uses the indefinite figure). Peak speed 2400 dps (~400 rpm) at 24V, backlash +/-0.2 deg (~12 arcmin). Currently not stocked on mjbots (MOQ 50); was ~$499 as a beta, so price left null. Marked beta by the vendor.

name: SCS15
notes: Older Feetech SCS-series bus servo using a potentiometer (not a magnetic encoder), ~200 deg servo range. Stall torque quoted across voltages: 15 kg.cm (1.47 N.m) @6V, 16.5 kg.cm @7.4V, 17 kg.cm (1.67 N.m) @8.4V; speed up to 73 rpm @8.4V. Half-duplex TTL multi-drop bus.

name: XL330-M288-T
notes: Tiny 5V smart servo with engineering-plastic gears. Stall torque 0.52 N.m and no-load 103 rpm quoted at 5.0V (falls to ~0.38 N.m / ~76 rpm at 3.7V). Widely used as the actuator for LeRobot Koch leader/follower arms and small hobby quadrupeds. Protocol 2.0.

name: GIM6010-8
notes: Compact 80 mm QDD joint, MIT-Cheetah-style. 11 Nm stall / 5 Nm rated, 8:1 steel planetary (~15 arcmin), nominal 120 rpm / max 420 rpm, 252W, 24V nominal (12-56V), continuous current 10.5A. SDC104 driver (CAN + USB-C). Weight ~388 g net. Often compared with Xiaomi CyberGear. Wholesale ~$50-100/unit (Alibaba, MOQ 2); no confirmed retail USD, so null.

name: XL430-W250-T
notes: Entry-level engineering-plastic-gear X servo. Stall torque quoted at multiple voltages: 1.0 N.m @9.0V, 1.4 N.m @11.1V, 1.5 N.m @12.0V; no-load 61 rpm @12V. No current-control mode (no current sensing). Used in TurtleBot3, OpenManipulator and hobby arms. Street price varies (~$27-50).

name: AK80-6 (KV100)
notes: Faster, lower-torque sibling of the AK80-9 (6:1 vs 9:1) used in exoskeletons and light legs. 600 rpm rated speed. max_speed_rpm listed is the manufacturer rated speed at 48V (no-load higher). Price ~$470 (CubeMars store $469.90).

name: XC430-W150-T
notes: Metal-gear version of the XL430 frame; lower gear ratio gives higher speed (106 rpm no-load @12V) with stall torque 1.6 N.m @12V. No current-control mode. Price (~$138 on robotis.us) is hard to verify and varies widely by region/reseller.

name: SC15 Serial Bus Servo (17 kg.cm)
notes: Lower-cost Waveshare/Feetech bus servo with potentiometer feedback (180 deg servo / 360 deg motor mode). Stall torque 14 kg.cm @4.8V, 15 kg.cm @6V, 17 kg.cm (1.67 N.m) @8.4V; no-load ~62 rpm (0.16 s/60 deg) @6V; stall current 1.7A. Price left null - retail listings ranged widely (~$15-22) and could not be reliably confirmed.

name: AK60-6 (V3.0 KV80)
notes: Smallest AK-series QDD; 9 Nm peak / 3 Nm rated, 380 g (V3.0). max_speed_rpm is rated speed at 48V (233 rpm at 24V). Older V1.1 KV140 variant is 368 g and rated to ~420 rpm. Price ~$427 (RobotShop, V3.0 KV80).

name: RI60 KV120
encoder: Optional Hall-sensor version; bare frameless kit (add own encoder)
notes: Motor. Frameless inrunner torque motor kit, dia 60 x 23 mm. Rated current 5.6A at 24V. Phase resistance 900 mOhm, inductance 877.5 uH. max_speed is no-load computed from KV120 x 48V (community estimate, not a published datasheet figure). Kt not published; approx 8.27/KV. Needs external FOC driver.

name: RI80 V2.0 KV75
encoder: Optional Hall-sensor version; bare frameless kit (add own encoder)
notes: Motor. Frameless inrunner torque motor, dia 85 x 82 mm. Rated current 9.4A. max_speed_rpm is the rated speed at 48V (no-load computed would be ~3600 rpm). Kt not published. Needs external FOC driver.

name: R60 KV115
encoder: Integrated Hall sensors (14 pole pairs); Ke 0.0087 V/rpm
notes: Motor. R-series torque motor (housed/framed with bearings + Hall sensors); the equivalent bare-frameless variants are the RO60 outrunner and RI60 inrunner. Rated current 9A. Needs an external FOC driver (e.g. ODrive/moteus). Km 0.171 Nm/sqrt(W).

name: RMD-L-9015-16T
notes: RMD-L is a direct-drive (gearless) outer-rotor gimbal-style actuator with integrated driver/encoder, not a geared joint reducer. Low torque, high speed, fully backdrivable; better suited to gimbals/light QDD than high-load arm joints. Nominal 1.64 N.m, max instantaneous 3.4 N.m, 780 rpm, 650 g.

name: iPower GM8112-80T
notes: Motor. Large gimbal/direct-drive motor, 36N/42P, dia 89.5 x 26 mm, hollow shaft 25 mm. Phase resistance 4.2 ohm. Torque figures converted from published 6000-9000 g-cm load torque (0.59-0.88 Nm); no-load current 0.3A, load current 2A. Low-Kv (80T) gimbal winding suited to low-speed direct-drive joints. Price is with-encoder variant (iFlight EU). Needs external FOC/gimbal driver.

name: DM-J10010-2EC
notes: MIT-driven integrated joint motor with built-in gearbox and dual encoders; supports MIT (impedance/torque), position and velocity modes. 100mm-class body, ~100 rpm class output. Peak 150 N.m is the MIT-mode short-duration figure, 40 N.m continuous. Weight not reliably confirmed from primary sources (some resellers list ~1 kg, unverified) so weight_g and torque_density left null to avoid fabrication. Price reseller/quote dependent.

name: DM-J8009-2EC
notes: 98mm OD integrated joint motor, MIT driver + dual magnetic encoders, CAN bus at 1 Mbps with telemetry (speed/position/torque/temperature). 20 N.m rated, 40 N.m peak, ~100 rpm rated output speed, 24V. Supports MIT, speed and position modes. Weight not confirmed from a primary source (left null, no torque density computed). DM-J8009P-2EC variant uses a crossed-roller output bearing instead of the deep-groove bearing.

name: GIM8115-36
notes: 8115-frame BLDC (mini-Cheetah style) with 36:1 planetary reducer and built-in driver; 54 N.m high-ratio variant of the GIM8115 family (also sold as -6/-9). ~30 rpm output, 160W, 36-48V. kt 0.28 N.m/A is the MOTOR-side torque constant (before the gearbox), phase resistance 0.43 ohm, inductance 0.27 mH. Rated (continuous) output torque not separately published (54 N.m is the stall/peak figure). Only a gross shipping weight (~1.2 kg incl. packaging) is listed by resellers, not a net actuator mass, so weight_g and torque_density left null. 36:1 ratio makes it largely non-backdrivable.

name: DriveSpin DS110 (TwinSpin cycloidal)
notes: True zero-backlash cycloidal (TwinSpin) rotary actuator: an AC servomotor coupled to a TwinSpin two-disc cycloidal reduction gear with an integrated high radial/axial-load output bearing. The DriveSpin DS series spans ~18-460 N.m rated output torque across sizes; the DS110 is a mid-large frame but Spinea does not publish a single rated-torque/weight number on the public page (varies by servomotor and ratio) so those are left null. Lost motion (backlash) <=1 arcmin, repeatable positioning accuracy <10 arcsec (~0.17 arcmin). Requires an external servo drive (integrated_driver false). Industrial/quote pricing. Not backdrivable.

name: RV-42N (RV-N cycloidal reducer)
notes: Nabtesco RV (Rotate Vector) two-stage cycloidal precision reducer -- the gear used in the shoulder/elbow/base joints of most industrial robots (Nabtesco holds ~60% of that market). This is a GEARBOX, not an integrated actuator: no motor, driver, encoder or voltage of its own (paired with a customer servomotor), hence those fields are null and integrated_driver false. RV-42N: 412 N.m rated output torque, available ratios up to ~185:1 (141:1 shown), <1 arcmin backlash. Peak/momentary max = 5x rated (~2060 N.m); permissible accel/decel torque is lower (~2.5x). Weight varies by ratio and is not a single published value. Quote-only pricing.

name: Arc Series Cycloidal Joint Actuator
notes: Integrated cycloidal joint module line aimed at humanoids/heavy arms: self-developed cycloidal reducer + BLDC motor + driver + dual encoders in one unit. Series-level specs: rated torque range 3-150 N.m across sizes, max torque up to 530 N.m (used as peak here), 24-72V, backlash and repeatability ~1 arcmin, withstands >5x rated momentary overload, CAN-FD + EtherCAT. Per-model rated torque, weight and gear ratio are not published individually (this entry represents the series envelope) so those are null. Low backdrivability by design. Quote/OEM pricing.

name: EC frameless 90 flat (260 W)
encoder: None (frameless rotor/stator kit; add own sensor)
notes: Motor. Part 542099, dia 90 mm flat frameless BLDC kit (rotor + stator supplied separately, no bearings/shaft). Continuous torque up to ~1 Nm; suited to gearless direct drive. maxon lists this part as NRND (not recommended for new designs). Kt/stall torque not confirmed from a primary datasheet (page fetch blocked); a comparable housed EC 90 flat 260W is rated ~0.96 Nm nominal / ~13.1 Nm stall (RS Components listing).

name: TQ-RoboDrive ILM85x26
encoder: None (frameless stator/rotor kit; add own sensor)
notes: Motor. Frameless hollow-shaft servo kit, dia 85 x 26 mm. Kt 73 mNm/A at 20C, Km 0.52 Nm/sqrt(W), rated current 39.8A, terminal resistance 27 mOhm, inductance 87 uH, no-load speed 5400 rpm. Nominal torque 2.9 Nm (VSS star-series winding per RoboDrive shop). High-end frameless kit for cobot/humanoid joints; needs external FOC driver.

name: Megaflux MF0127 (frameless)
encoder: None (frameless rotor/stator kit; add own sensor)
notes: Motor. Frameless direct-drive brushless torque motor, ~127 mm frame diameter (part of Megaflux MF family, 60-330 mm frames, multiple stack lengths). Per-winding specs (Kt, continuous stall / peak torque, weight) not captured: manufacturer datasheet PDF fetch was blocked by network policy. Family continuous stall torque ranges up to ~181 Nm (standard series). Cite the linked MF0127 datasheet for exact values.

name: ODrive v3.6
notes: Driver/controller. Dual-axis FOC BLDC controller. Sold in 24V (12-24V) and 56V (12-56V) variants; 120A peak per motor. Classic CAN (not CAN-FD). Now marked NRND (not recommended for new designs); ODrive steers new builds to the S1. Price no longer listed on official store.

name: ODrive S1
encoder: Onboard MA702 magnetic encoder; supports SPI/Hall/quadrature/RS485 offboard
notes: Driver/controller. Single-axis FOC BLDC controller. 12-50V (58V abs max), 40A continuous with heat spreader, 120A peak. 1600W continuous. CAN 2.0B @1Mbps plus experimental CAN-FD @5Mbps; also STEP/DIR, PWM, analog. Trajectory + feed-forward control. Common choice for DIY QDD actuators.

name: ODrive Pro
encoder: Onboard MA702 magnetic encoder; supports offboard SPI/Hall/quadrature
notes: Driver/controller. Single-axis FOC BLDC controller, 12-56V (58V abs max), 70A continuous (with heatsink+fan), 120A peak, ~5kW peak power. Semi-isolated or fully isolated CAN-FD transceiver. Higher-current sibling of the S1; regenerative braking. Volume pricing to ~$214.

name: moteus r4.11
notes: Driver/controller. Compact single-axis FOC controller designed for QDD/legged robots. 10-44V, 100A peak phase current, 12A uncooled / 32A cooled continuous, ~900W peak @30V. 5Mbps CAN-FD native. Developer kit ~$219. Widely used in low-cost QDD actuator builds.

name: moteus c1
notes: Driver/controller. Smaller/lower-power single-axis FOC controller. 10-51V, 20A peak phase current, 5A uncooled / 14A cooled continuous, ~250W peak @28V. 5Mbps CAN-FD. Developer kit ~$149. Good for lighter arm/QDD joints.

name: VESC 6 MkVI
encoder: Sensorless, Hall, ABI, AS5047 SPI encoder support; onboard IMU
notes: Driver/controller. Open-source VESC-based single-axis FOC controller. 11.1-48V (3S-12S, 60V abs max spikes), 80A continuous / 120A peak (temperature dependent). Ports: USB, CAN, UAVCAN, 2x UART, SPI, I2C. Price ~USD 255 (GBP 200) from Trampa. Classic CAN (not CAN-FD).

name: TMC4671 FOC servo controller
encoder: ABN incremental, Hall, analog/digital, SinCos, SPI absolute (external)
notes: Driver/controller. Fully integrated hardware-FOC servo controller IC for BLDC/PMSM/stepper/DC (not a turnkey board); paired with a power stage or reference design. Reference designs span voltage/current: TMC4671-TOSV-REF 12-36V up to 6A RMS; TMC4671-LEV-REF up to 55V / ~500W. Control via SPI/UART plus Step/Dir; supports many encoder types. Board/IC price varies by vendor (not listed here).

name: FHA-14C-100 (FHA-C Mini)
encoder: dual absolute (15-bit motor input, 14-bit output), battery-less within one turn
notes: Compact hollow-shaft AC servo actuator: pancake BLDC motor + zero-backlash Harmonic Drive strain-wave gear. FHA-C Mini family sizes 8C/11C/14C with ratios 30/50/100:1. 'Zero backlash' is the manufacturer's strain-wave claim (recorded as 0). Positioning accuracy ~90 arc-sec (=1.5 arcmin) for FHA-14C-100; repeatability not confirmed in accessible sources. 24VDC integrated-drive version communicates via CANopen (4-wire) with EtherCAT option. rated_torque 28 N·m is the value listed by distributors; separate momentary/peak torque not confirmed from a primary source, so peak and torque_density left null. Weight ~1.65 kg approximate (distributor listing). Quote-only pricing.

name: SHA-CG series (SHA-CG Hollow Shaft Actuator)
encoder: magnetic dual absolute, output resolution up to ~20,971,520 pulse/rev
notes: Hollow-shaft AC servo actuator combining CSG zero-backlash strain-wave gear with a brushless servomotor and integrated servo drive (EtherCAT/CANopen). 4 frame sizes, 5 reduction ratios 50:1-160:1. Series delivers up to 3,400 N·m across sizes; positional accuracy better than 1 arcmin and repeatability better than +/-5 arc-sec (recorded as ~0.08 arcmin). Per-size rated/peak torque, weight and speed not captured from a primary datasheet in accessible sources (manufacturer PDFs were egress-blocked this session), so left null rather than guessed. 'Zero backlash' recorded as 0 per manufacturer strain-wave claim. Quote-only pricing.

name: CHA series (Hollow Shaft Servo Actuator)
notes: CHA hollow-shaft servo actuator: synchronous servomotor + CPU-H series zero-backlash strain-wave gear + high-capacity precision output bearing. Available in eight sizes, gear ratios 30:1-160:1, maximum torque range from about 8 N·m up to 1,840 N·m across the size range. Requires a matching external servo drive (CANopen/EtherCAT drives offered). Per-size rated/peak torque, weight, speed and repeatability not captured from a primary datasheet in accessible sources (egress-blocked), so left null. Backlash recorded 0 per strain-wave zero-backlash claim. Quote-only pricing.

name: LHS series (Harmonic Drive strain-wave reducer)
notes: Strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component - a Harmonic Drive alternative used to build precision robot-arm joints, not a motorized actuator, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Sizes ~14/17/20/25/32/40 with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1. Rated output torque spans roughly 3.8 N·m (smallest size) to ~279 N·m (size 40) per distributor listings; specific per-size/ratio values not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed as zero-backlash (recorded 0); transmission accuracy / lost motion typically about 1 arcmin but not confirmed here. Quote-only pricing.

name: LHD series (hollow-shaft harmonic reducer)
notes: Compact hollow-shaft strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component for robot-arm joints; no integrated motor, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Seven sizes (14/17/20/25/32/40 and larger) with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1; directindustry lists a coaxial hollow-shaft variant in the ~100-200 N·m class. Per-size rated/peak torque and weight not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed zero-backlash (recorded 0). Quote-only pricing.

name: LCS series (cup-type harmonic reducer)
notes: Cup-type strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component used to build precision arm joints; no integrated motor, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Sizes 8/14/17/20/25/32/40/50 with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1. Per-size rated/peak torque and weight not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed zero-backlash (recorded 0). Quote-only pricing.

name: FLEXWAVE WPG series (strain-wave gearhead)
notes: FLEXWAVE strain-wave (harmonic) gearing from Nidec Drive Technology (formerly Nidec-Shimpo). This is a zero-backlash gear unit / gearhead component (flexspline, circular spline, wave generator), not a motorized actuator, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. FLEXWAVE spans ~5 frame sizes (approx 35-80 mm) with ratios from 50:1 up to 160:1 (single stage) and maximum torque up to about 346 N·m across the range. Marketed zero-backlash and fully back-drivable with high repeatability; per-size rated torque and repeatability-in-arc-sec not confirmed from a primary datasheet here, so left null. Quote-only pricing.

name: Smart-FLEXWAVE SRH series (smart strain-wave reducer)
notes: Smart-FLEXWAVE (SRH / WPU-SRH-BD) is Nidec Drive Technology's ultra-thin/lightweight zero-backlash strain-wave 'smart reducer' with built-in sensing, aimed at humanoid and cobot joints. It is a reducer-with-sensor module (no integrated motor or drive), so torque/electrical/comms fields are left null pending a primary datasheet (catalog PDFs egress-blocked this session). Zero-backlash recorded as 0. Quote-only pricing.

name: RMD-X6-8 V3
notes: Entry-level planetary joint module (MC-X-300 driver built in). Peak torque per RobotShop V3 1:8 listing; other listings quote ~10 N.m. Net weight not published on primary sources (listings vary ~335-450 g), so torque density left null.

name: RMD-X8 Pro V2 (1:9)
notes: Popular arm/leg joint module. Peak 25 N.m and rated 13 N.m per RobotShop/MyActuator; continuous current ~5 A, nominal speed 122 rpm / ~160 rpm no-load at 48 V. Only gross shipping weight (~1.1 kg incl. packaging) is published on listings, so net weight and torque density left null.

name: MG5010E-i36 V3
notes: LKMTech planetary joint motor with built-in driver and dual 18-bit encoders. V3 rated/peak torque 13/25 N.m at 36:1; base i36 variant listed at 4 N.m and ~74 rpm at 24 V. Net weight not published on primary sources.

name: PH54-200-S500-R (Dynamixel-P / Pro+)
notes: Top-end Dynamixel-P (Pro+) joint for humanoids/large arms. Robotis publishes an estimated continuous/rated torque of 44.7 N.m at 24V (29 rpm, 9.3A); no clean peak/stall torque figure is published, so peak and torque_density are left null. Backlash <0.1 deg (~6 arcmin). 200W. RS-485 only.

name: PM54-060-S250-R (Dynamixel-P / Pro+)
notes: Mid-tier 60W Dynamixel-P (Pro+) joint. Robotis lists estimated rated torque 10.1 N.m at 24V; no clean peak/stall figure published, so peak/density left null. Backlash ~6 arcmin. Weight left null - a distributor listing reported 855 g but that appears copied from the PH54 and is unverified. RS-485 only.

name: LX-16A
notes: Full-metal-gear serial bus servo popular in SpotMicro-class hobby quadrupeds and the Hiwonder xArm. Stall torque 17 kg.cm (1.67 N.m) @6V and 19.5 kg.cm (1.91 N.m) @7.4V; speed 0.19 s/60 deg (~53 rpm) @7.4V; 240 deg range; stall current 2.4-3A; position accuracy 0.3 deg. Uses a private half-duplex TTL protocol (needs Hiwonder debug board). Weight not published on primary sources, left null. Price approximate.
